title: Modify Utils
description: Makes specific custom items render bigger on the ground — with item locking, multiple render modes, and full in-game configuration!
body:
# Modify Utils

Modify Utils makes valuable dropped items render larger on the ground — so you never lose track of important items on a custom server again!

---

## ✨ Features

- Valuable dropped items render **visually larger** on the ground
- Detects items by **custom name**, **item type**, or **both**
- Fully configurable scales from **0.1x to 4.0x** per item
- **Item Lock** — prevents protected items from being accidentally dropped
- Multiple **render modes** for balancing visibility and performance
- Custom item rules using item ID, item path, or display-name matching
- **In-game settings screen** with quick hotkeys
- Lightweight **client-side only** — no server installation needed

---

## 🗡️ Supported Items

**Swords & Weapons**
- Dash Sword, Strike Sword, Executioner Sword
- Void Sword, Lifesteal Sword, Inhibitor Sword
- Knockback Sword, Axe of Protection, Axe of Resistance

**Tools**
- Instant Mine Pickaxe, Punch Bow

**Tokens**
- Kill Token, Mining Token, Wood Token
- Compressed Mining Token, Compressed Axe Token, Compressed Kill Token

**Special Items**
- Enchanted Golden Apple, Chorus Fruit, Wind Charge
- Ender Pearl, Blue Ice, Obsidian, Stone Brick Wall
- Spectral Arrow

**Armor**
- All trimmed armor pieces

**Custom Items**
- Any item you define yourself via the config!

---

## 🎨 Render Modes

| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| **Vanilla** | Normal rendering unless a valuable item is modified |
| **Performance** | Non-valuable items render tiny |
| **Ultra Performance** | Non-valuable items are hidden entirely |
| **Near Only** | Non-valuable items only render close to the player |

---

## ⌨️ Hotkeys

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **L** | Toggle Item Lock |
| **M** | Toggle Modify Mode |
| **N** | Cycle Render Mode |
| **B** | Cycle Detection Mode |
| **O** | Open Settings |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Open **Mod Menu** in-game and click on **Modify Utils** to adjust scales, detection modes, render modes, and custom item rules — all without leaving the game.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.16.0+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- Java 21+
